# IconButton

Icon button: a button that is an icon and nothing else. `label` is required because it is the button's accessible name and its tooltip. A filter trigger can add `trailingMetric`, the count of filters applied, drawn after the icon.

Also asked as: icon only button, icon action.

**Import:** `import { IconButton } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use an icon button when space is limited and the glyph clearly matches the action: a toolbar, a table row, a card header. Where space allows, or the action is important, use a Button with a text label.

## Motion

IconButton reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Hover and press change color, 90% by about 110 ms. |

## Best practices

### Keep space between icon buttons. {#keep-space-between-icon-buttons}

Leave a gap so neighboring icon buttons read as separate targets.

Do: A clear gap between icon buttons.
Don't: Icon buttons touching.

### Always give it an accessible name. {#always-give-it-an-accessible-name}

Every icon button carries a `label` that is its accessible name and its
tooltip, such as "Close panel". Name the object acted on: "Edit page", not a
bare "Edit", which does not say what is edited. The label is never drawn, so
the difference shows only on hover, on focus and to a screen reader.

```jsx
// Incorrect: a bare verb.
<IconButton icon="pen" label="Edit" />

// Correct: the action and its object.
<IconButton icon="pen" label="Edit page" />
```

### Keep it square. {#keep-it-square}

Icon buttons stay 32 or 24 square, and round only in top navigation
(`shape="circle"`). Icon button has no prop to fill its container; never
stretch one to fill a row. The one exception is a filter trigger's count,
which widens the button by the count alone.

### Show the applied count on a filter trigger. {#show-the-applied-count-on-a-filter-trigger}

When filters are on, pass their number as `trailingMetric`. A count above zero draws the
selected fill by itself; zero or absent draws no count and no fill.

```jsx
<IconButton icon="filter" label="Filters" trailingMetric={applied} />
```

### Use primary sparingly. {#use-primary-sparingly}

Primary marks the main action of a small area. The other icon buttons beside
it stay default or subtle.

Do: One primary icon button, with the other actions subtle.
Don't: Three primary icon buttons compete for attention.

### Pick a glyph people know. {#pick-a-glyph-people-know}

If you cannot find a suitable glyph in five seconds, it probably will not communicate the action. Check the meaning holds across cultures and languages, and do not reuse one glyph for several meanings.

### Group icon buttons that act together. {#group-icon-buttons-that-act-together}

Put related icon buttons in a Button group, and use `isSelected` for a choice between views.

Do: Grid and list views joined in one group, with the current view selected.
Don't: The same two views as loose buttons read as unrelated actions.

## Accessibility

- `label` is required. It is the accessible name and the tooltip. A missing label fails `check:icon-button-name`.
- Leave an action enabled and explain what is missing when it is pressed; disable an icon button only while it is sending. A disabled icon button leaves the tab order, drops its tooltip and `title`, and takes no `aria-disabled` stand-in that keeps it focusable. Say why in visible text beside it.
- Selected is not color alone: `isSelected` sets `aria-pressed`. A menu trigger reports `aria-expanded` only, so it never carries `aria-pressed`.
- With `trailingMetric` the accessible name carries the count: "Filters, 2 applied". A count of zero adds nothing to the name. The drawn digits are hidden from assistive technology so the count is not read twice.
- The focus ring is 2px in `--ds-border-focused`. Never remove it.
- The glyph is decoration once the button has a name, so it is hidden from assistive technology.

## Related

- To act with a label, use Button.
- To navigate with an icon, use Link icon button.
- To dismiss a surface, use Close button.
- To group related icon buttons, use Button group.

## Parts

1. **Container.** A square, 32 at default spacing and 24 at compact. `shape="circle"` rounds it for top navigation.
2. **Icon.** A Font Awesome Free glyph at 16. Use an existing system glyph; do not draw custom icons.
3. **Label.** Not drawn. It is the accessible name and the tooltip on hover and focus.
4. **Spinner** (loading only). Replaces the icon while the button is busy.
5. **Count** (filter triggers only). `trailingMetric`, the number of filters applied, after the icon. The button keeps its height and the icon keeps its place; the count widens it.

### Appearance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Most icon buttons: an action with a clear, familiar glyph. Example: Edit page. |
| Subtle | Icon buttons in toolbars, table rows and headers where it is already clear they are interactive. Example: More actions in a row. |
| Primary | The main action of a small area when space allows no label. Use sparingly. Example: Send comment. |
| Discovery | The call to action for a new experience. Example: Try the new view. |

### Spacing

Default spacing suits most places. Use compact in table rows and inline toolbars.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Hovered | The container takes the appearance's hovered fill. |
| Pressed | The container takes the appearance's pressed fill. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the edge, for keyboard focus only. |
| Selected | The selected role fill and icon. Applies to default and subtle, and sets `aria-pressed`. |
| Disabled | The disabled fill and icon. Avoid disabling icon buttons. |
| Loading | A spinner replaces the icon. The container keeps its fill, blocks interaction and sets `aria-busy`. |
| Count changes | The first count opens the button to its width; set at the end of a toolbar, the right edge stays put and it grows left. Each new count fades in; it never counts up. With reduced motion both are instant. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Fill: default, subtle | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle`, hovered and pressed steps. Default adds a 1px `--ds-border-input` edge. |
| Fill: primary, discovery | `--ds-background-brand-bold`, `--ds-background-discovery-bold`, each with hovered and pressed steps. |
| Fill: selected, disabled | `--ds-background-selected` with hovered and pressed steps; `--ds-background-disabled`. |
| Icon | `--ds-icon-subtle` (default, subtle), `--ds-icon-inverse` (primary, discovery); the selected and disabled roles. 16, `--icon-md`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |
| Size | 32: `--item-height-md`. 24: `--item-height-sm`. Square, except with a count. |
| Count | `--ds-text-subtlest`, or the selected text color when selected. `--inline-sm` after the icon. Motion: `--ds-motion-appearance-default` to open, `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` to fade in. |
| Radius | 6: `--button-radius-default`. Compact 4: `--button-radius-compact`. Circle 50%. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the object acted on: "Edit page", "Delete session". | A bare verb such as "Edit", or a label that repeats the glyph: "Pencil icon". |
| Use sentence case: "Copy link". | Title case: "Copy Link". |
| Describe the action, not the picture. | Describe the picture: "Trash can". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `icon` | string or node | — | A Font Awesome Free glyph name (`trash`) or a node. |
| `label` | string (required) | — | The accessible name and tooltip. Sentence case; name the object acted on ("Edit page"). |
| `trailingMetric` | number or string | — | The count of filters applied, drawn after the icon; the accessible name becomes "Filters, 2 applied". Zero or absent draws no count, and a count above zero draws the selected fill by itself. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'default'` | The visual style. `default` suits most actions, `subtle` low-emphasis toolbar actions, `primary` the main action and `discovery` something new. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws 32. `compact` draws 24. |
| `shape` | enum | `'default'` | Square by default; `circle` is for top navigation. |
| `isSelected` | bool | — | Marks the button selected and sets `aria-pressed` (leave it unset and the button reports none), except on a menu trigger, which reports `aria-expanded` only. Use it for a toggle such as a list or grid view switch. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Prevents interaction and drops the tooltip and `title`. Leave an action enabled and explain what is missing when it is pressed; disable only while it is sending. |
| `isLoading` | bool | — | Shows a spinner in place of the icon and blocks interaction. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Called with the click event when the button is activated. It does not fire while `isDisabled` or `isLoading` is set. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names added to the button element beside the component's own. |
| `title` | string | — | Sets the native `title` tooltip. Defaults to `label`; `tooltip` or `isTooltipDisabled` suppresses that default. |
| `tooltip` | node | — | Overrides the tooltip content shown on hover/focus; defaults to `label` when set. |
| `isTooltipDisabled` | bool | `false` | Suppresses the tooltip and native title entirely. |
